positioning: For reMarkable 2, Paper Pro and Paper Pure owners who want one planner that simply works on their tablet: a dated 2027 planner that starts Monday, October 26, 2026, drawn for e-ink (an exact 3:4 page that fills the screen, grayscale, crisp mid-gray lines, nothing hidden under the toolbar), with every date linked and a setup check page. Top sellers sell big bundles of loose templates, and their buyers' biggest complaints are pages that did not fit the device, would not load or were not useful, so this one wins by fitting the screen and working the first time.

must_haves.what: Made for reMarkable e-ink tablets: one portrait PDF at the 3:4 shape of the reMarkable 2, Paper Pro and Paper Pure screens, named in the title, tags and listing.

Dated 2027, Monday-start, every date linked: year page to day, month to its weeks and days, week to each day, day to the previous and next day, plus a head start from Monday, October 26, 2026 so a buyer this autumn can start this week.
The core pages buyers use daily: year at a glance, 12 month pages with a focus box, a habit tracker per month, every week, every day with time blocks, a projects page, lined notes and dot grid pages.
A finished, designed look that suits e-ink: clean typography, consistent spacing, no decoration that turns to gray noise on the screen.
Setup instructions printed inside the file, written for reMarkable (how to get the PDF onto the tablet, how to tap links), not only in a separate PDF or video.

fixes.how: Pages are 768 x 1024 portrait, exactly the 3:4 shape of the reMarkable 2, Paper Pro and Paper Pure screens, so the page fills the screen with no gray bands (the 'only fills 2/3 of my screen' complaint). The left edge keeps a wider clear gutter so nothing sits under the toolbar when it is open, all colors are grays that e-ink shows cleanly, and lines are thin vector strokes so the pen feels the same as on a plain notebook. The listing has a Works with / Not for box: works on reMarkable 2, Paper Pro and Paper Pure; not sized for the Paper Pro Move, phones or iPad apps. The Setup check page proves it on the buyer's own tablet.

One PDF, not a zip, kept well under 19 MB. Listing copy, photo 4 and the Start here page give the route in plain steps: download from Etsy in a web browser (the Etsy app cannot download files), then drag the PDF into the free reMarkable desktop app or my.remarkable.com, or use the tablet's USB web interface. The listing says no Connect subscription is needed.

Every listing photo is a crop of the built file at readable size, captioned with the page name; no mockup shows anything the file lacks. The description says plainly: a linked PDF notebook you write in, not a template installed into the reMarkable template menu; no handwriting-to-text; portrait only; Monday-start; exact page count; which tablets it fits. Photo 10 repeats this next to the Contents page.

Every date, month tab, week chip and button is a plain internal PDF link, checked at build (0 broken links, every page reachable from the cover). The Setup check page has buttons that jump to a month, the year and Contents and back, so the buyer sees links work before planning.

Three ways to move on every calendar page: month tabs down the right edge, a top bar (Home, Year, Projects, Notes) and a Month / Week trail that works as a back button ('no back to index'). Every date on a month page opens its day ('won't navigate from the monthly calendar to a specific day'), day pages have previous and next arrows, and the Contents page links every section and month.

The cover's Open planner button lands on a 4-step Start here page written for reMarkable (get the PDF onto the tablet, check the links, tap with your finger to jump and write with the pen, plan one day), followed by the Setup check page. Both are the first cards on the Contents page.

One focused planner instead of a pile of loose templates: year, month, week and day pages that link to each other, so it works as a weekly planner and a daily planner at once ('I need a weekly planner'). It is dated, so there is nothing to set up: tap today and write. Photo 2 shows a day page and photo 6 a week page close up, at reading size, so buyers can judge fit before buying.

The listing gives exact counts from the built file (every day page, every week, 12 months, 12 habit trackers, 10 notes pages, 6 dot grid pages, a projects page) and no inflated template counts. Every day has its own full page with a Notes box and a Done today box, so there is room for more than one line of daily notes.

Priced with the full planners buyers actually pay for, and the full price buys a complete dated year plus a 2026 head start in one file that fits the device, instead of a bundle of duplicates. Writing space is generous: time blocks from 6am to 10pm, an 8-line to-do list and open notes on every day, text at 1.15 scale. A 25% launch sale for 30 days lowers the first price without making it look cheap.

Pages run in strict date order (head start, then each 2027 month followed by its habit tracker, weeks and days), each week and day appears once, the build checks 0 broken links and no overflowing text, and all text and lines are vector so they stay sharp at any zoom on e-ink. All art is our own; no borrowed photos.

Most support messages are 'it will not load' or 'links do not work' questions, so the answers are in the file and the listing: the Setup check page's 'Nothing happened?' list written for reMarkable (tap with your finger, open the uploaded PDF, update the tablet software, then send an Etsy message with your tablet model), the Start here steps, and a listing FAQ with the top five problems. Reply speed is shop-level, not something the file can promise.

unique.name: Drawn for e-ink, not shrunk from an iPad planner
unique.what: An exact 3:4 page that fills the reMarkable screen, pure white paper and grays only (no colors that turn muddy on a grayscale screen), mid-gray thin lines that stay visible without looking heavy, a clear left gutter for the toolbar, and lines drawn as light vector strokes so pages turn fast.
unique.why: Device fit is the second biggest complaint cluster (36 'does not work on my device', 6 'slow or laggy', 7 'text too small'), with quotes about pages filling 2/3 of the screen and the pen feeling wrong. Top seller titles name the devices but none promise the page is drawn for them.

unique.name: Working in five minutes, and you can check it
unique.what: Page 3 is a 4-step Start here guide for reMarkable and page 4 is a Setup check page with buttons that jump and return, a pen test area and a fix list if links do nothing. The cover's Open planner button lands on Start here.
unique.why: Download (34), setup (23), links (24) and 'does not work' (11) complaints are all buyers who could not get the file going. No top seller shows a quick start or link test in their titles.

unique.name: Time-blocked day with a Top 3
unique.what: Every day page has Top 3, an 8-line to-do list, time blocks from 6am to 10pm, Notes and Done today in the same places every day. The week page carries This week's top 3.
unique.why: Time blocking and a top 3 are not seen in any top seller title, a buyer asked for a wider daily time range, and 'only one page for daily notes' shows day pages are too thin elsewhere.

unique.name: Start this week, not in January
unique.what: Head start pages from Monday, October 26 to December 31, 2026 (month, week and day pages) before the full 2027 year, linked from the Year page and the Contents page.
unique.why: Multi-year cover is common in titles but only a third of top sellers have it; an autumn buyer otherwise waits two months to use a 2027 planner.

waived.reason: The Paper Pro Move has a much taller, narrower screen than the 3:4 tablets; one file cannot fill both. Shipping one exact size beats a stretched page (the 2/3 of the screen complaint). The listing says it is not sized for the Move; a Move edition can be a later separate listing.

Bundles are common, but their buyers complain about duplicates, inflated template counts and pages they never use (c_missing, c_not_useful, c_overwhelm). This is one focused planner and the listing says so.
Only dated pages can link every date, and the head start covers buyers who start before January. An undated edition would be a second full build and a separate listing.
The reMarkable 2 and Paper Pure show grayscale only, and color on the Paper Pro is muted; a colorful planner would turn into uneven grays. Grayscale is the point of this product.
The planner line builds one PDF and reMarkable has no sticker tool. The listing says there are no stickers so nobody goes looking for them.

look.direction: Quiet and sharp, made for paper-like screens. Pure white paper (any tint dithers into gray dots on e-ink), near-black ink at about 18:1 contrast, secondary text in dark gray at about 8:1, and mid-gray 1px lines that show clearly on e-ink without competing with handwriting. Filled boxes such as Top 3 are a single light gray. Month tabs step from light to mid gray with black labels. Outfit headings are geometric with solid strokes that do not break up on e-ink; Manrope body text at 1.15 scale stays readable at arm's length. No motif, no florals, no photos. Reads well in daylight and under the Paper Pro's reading light; no dark pages, because large dark areas ghost on e-ink.
avoid: beige and greige minimalism used by many top sellers
colorful or pastel palettes that turn into muddy grays on e-ink
very pale hairlines that vanish on e-ink
script fonts, florals and photo mockup backgrounds

price.why: Inside the best-earning band ($56 to $73) and at the sales-weighted price buyers actually pay ($68.60), so it sits with the full-system listings rather than the $7 to $21 single templates (style rule r015). The value case is a complete dated year plus a 2026 head start that fits the device and works first time. While the shop is new, a 25% Etsy sale for 30 days shows $51.75 with $69 crossed out.

sections.label: Start here
steps: Download the PDF from Etsy in a web browser (the Etsy app cannot download files). Drag it into the free reMarkable desktop app or my.remarkable.com, or use the USB web interface. No subscription is needed.
Open the Setup check page and tap the buttons. If they jump, you are ready. If not, the fix list is on that page.
Tap to jump, write to plan
Tap a date, tab or button with your finger to jump there. Write with the pen anywhere on the page. Close the toolbar to see the whole page.
Tap Year, then today's date. Before 2027? Tap Head start on the Year page: the first page is Monday, October 26, 2026. Fill your Top 3 and one time block. That is today done.
sections.tip: Missed a few days? Leave them blank and jump straight to today. A planner works from whatever day you come back.

new_modules.name: eink_format
new_modules.what: A format section placed first in spec.sections that prints no page and switches the planner into reMarkable e-ink mode for the whole file: (1) widen the left page gutter (body, nav and foot left edge) to left_gutter px so content clears the reMarkable toolbar; (2) draw .lines and .dots writing areas as plain vector strokes and dots (SVG or bordered elements) instead of CSS repeating gradients, and confirm in the built PDF that they are vector paths, not images or pattern fills, so pages turn fast on e-ink; (3) when grayscale is true, fail validation if any theme color (paper, ink, muted, line, accent, soft, warm, tabs) has saturation, and render index cards and month tabs without color tints; (4) when week_layout is 'rows' in portrait, lay the week page out as two columns of day boxes (Mon to Thu left, Fri to Sun plus Notes right) with the side blocks in a row underneath, instead of the landscape 4 x 2 grid beside a side column, so each day box is about 330px wide instead of about 115px; apply the same to head start week pages; (5) link_test uses link_test_fixes for its 'Nothing happened?' list and pen_label for the pen test box instead of the built-in Goodnotes wording.
new_modules.why: The line can already output the reMarkable 3:4 shape (portrait 768 x 1024) and a gray theme by token overrides, but its writing lines are gradients, its portrait week page is a squeezed landscape grid, and its setup check text tells buyers to turn a Goodnotes pen off. These are the device-fit, lag and setup complaints (c_device 36, c_lag 6, c_setup 23, c_space 7) this product exists to fix. A section module is used rather than a loose spec field so the build blocks until it is implemented.
